title: Speech Accent Archive
citation: Weinberger, Steven H. Speech Accent Archive. George Mason University.

governance.retention_or_deletion_duties: Do not acquire, retain, upload or process source data while the recorded rights state blocks use.

population.description: Speakers of many first languages each reading one fixed English paragraph, with narrow phonetic transcription.
limitations: The non commercial licence excludes it from this project.
ShareAlike would additionally attach to anything derived from it and distributed.
One fixed paragraph per speaker cannot supply the per phone opportunity counts this project's gates are defined over.
